purpose: Fixed two-pass full-image then original-source crop experiment through the existing public analysis queue.

protocol.compression: Both A and B are JPEG85 uploads; the same public API decodes and re-encodes each as JPEG85 again.
limitations: Small purposive panel, no expert accuracy estimate or production decision.
Crop selected by A may be wrong or omit the defect; no B when A abstains.
Crop reduces context. It does not add source detail; native minimum-size upscaling is interpolation.
No worker THW shape in the public API; record actual native grid-cell count and input tokens only.
Timings include queue and API overhead; no isolation, no warmup or latency stability claim.
protocol.order: For each fixed image: A full -> eligible B crop. One pending queued request, no POST retry.
protocol.writes: Temporary analysis API records only; never /api/inspections or /api/history.

summary.errorScope: Counts cover errors surfaced by the queued public API; raw worker JSON is not exposed by this endpoint.

artifactVerification.jpegReencodingByteEquality: Not tested locally: local Pillow13 differs from preparation12.3; stored SHA/bytes/dimensions verified.

interpretationLimits: Quality and accuracy remain pending paired visual review. No production crop behavior was enabled.
All12 full-image calls and the6 eligible pairs are different populations; compare two-pass timing only with the paired6 full-image calls.
Elapsed times include queue/polling/API overhead and are one measurement per image. The sum excludes crop preparation and is not end-to-end UI latency.
Actual native grid-cell counts come from API metrics.patches. THW tensors and raw worker JSON are unavailable; no shape or hidden reasoning is inferred.
Source sample retention is not newly captured detail or proof of more accurate interpretation. Cropping removes surrounding context.
Six crops were skipped because padded boxes covered85% or more of the original; no manual target selection replaced the model box.
Prepared inputs are derived from EXIF-oriented originals. JPEG byte reproduction across Pillow/library versions was not claimed; original/input hashes, sizes and geometry were verified.

qualityReview.reviewer: Independent AI visual comparison, not expert ground truth
qualityReview.blindingLimit: Aliases X/Y only; per-image framing can reveal crop, and earlier reference/model history was known. This is not perfect blinding.

pairs.reason: Узел, коррозия и смысл текста одинаковы; новая полезная информация не появилась.
Оба ответа выбирают левый насос с видимыми локальными ржавыми зонами. Более краткая формулировка Y не является доказанным улучшением диагностики.
Y корректнее называет видимый фитинг/трубное соединение. X добавляет неподтверждённый клапан. Оба сохраняют чрезмерно уверенную коррозию.
X добавляет неподтверждённую коррозию изоляции; Y не содержит этой дополнительной ошибки. При этом оба ответа всё ещё необоснованно уверены в коррозии.
Оба правильно находят видимую жидкость на том же клапане; оба необоснованно называют её водой. Увеличение не добавляет нового установленного признака.
Повреждение изоляции и выбранный участок одинаково обоснованы, текст совпадает.

qualityReview.rootIndependentPairedReview: Root separately reviewed the six paired images before reading the mask key; also preferred full views in images12/16, with four ties. Additional context loss in16: the cropped view omits a loose ring terminal visible in the original. The main selected region remains visible.
qualityReview.promotionDecision: Keep the single-pass production default. Do not enable automatic crop-only second passes from this experiment.
qualityReview.nextHypothesis: Retain the higher-resolution original and give the second pass both the overview and crop. This joint-image variant has NOT been tested here; evaluate on high-resolution wide scenes with small components and clean/ambiguous controls.
